name: Three Borders Highlands
inspired_by: The South Caucasus where Georgia, Armenia and Azerbaijan meet, as of 2026: a high volcanic plateau with lakes, forested Lesser Caucasus ridges and deep river gorges, the lowland Kura-type valley to the east with an oil-and-gas pipeline corridor toward Turkey, an administrative boundary line of a Russian-occupied region on the north edge, a Russian base on the west side, and a planned US-backed transit corridor road in the south. The Armenia-Azerbaijan peace treaty was initialled in August 2025 but not signed. All towns are fictional.
climate: Varied by altitude: continental highland (Koppen Dfb) on the plateau at 1,800-2,200 m with cold snowy winters (-10 to -20 C) and cool summers; humid temperate (Cfa/Cfb) in the forested gorges; semi-arid (BSk) in the eastern lowland with hot summers (32-38 C). 400-800 mm precipitation, heavy snow on the ridges.
seasons: Winter (Dec-Mar): deep snow on the plateau and ridges, closed passes, frozen lakes
Spring (Apr-May): snowmelt, flooding gorges, green pastures, mud
Summer (Jun-Sep): shepherds and herds on high pastures, hot lowland, thunderstorms on ridges
Autumn (Oct-Nov): grape and fruit harvest in the gorges, forests turn, first snow above 2,000 m

vegetation: tamarisk and tugai forest on the river
pistachio and juniper on dry hills

terrain.relief: A high volcanic plateau (1,800-2,200 m) with crater lakes and cinder cones in the west; forested ridges (2,000-3,200 m) and deep river gorges (600-1,200 m) across the centre; the land drops east to a broad semi-arid valley at 300-500 m.
features: volcanic plateau with crater lakes and cinder cones
deep basalt-walled river gorges with canyon villages
a broad lowland river valley with tugai forest
a buried oil-and-gas pipeline corridor with block-valve stations
the administrative boundary line of an occupied region on the north edge (fences and signs that move)
old trench lines and mined border hills from past wars (marked hazards)
terrain.water: A gorge river flowing east to a lowland river; crater and plateau lakes; a reservoir in the lowland; mountain streams; snowmelt torrents in spring.

generator.approach: Heightmap at 10 m. Plateau as a high flat mask with cellular cones and crater depressions in the west; ridged noise for the forested ridges; gorges carved by flow accumulation then steepened (basalt walls); an east-west ramp down to the lowland where a wide river spline and tugai belt sit.

noise_layers.type: cellular (Worley F1, inverted) + crater rim profile

generator.erosion: Hydraulic erosion (100 iterations) on ridges; gorge walls kept vertical with a basalt mask (thermal cap 75 degrees).
generator.rivers: Gorge river by flow accumulation, widened in the lowland to a meandering spline with a reservoir; crater lakes filled by basin.
generator.settlement_flattening: Plateau villages flattened as clusters; gorge villages on terraces at the canyon rim and floor; lowland towns flattened.
generator.notes: Roads cross the gorges on a few bridges and climb passes; borders between three states and one occupied line cross the map, so convoy routes change with border status. Mined hills are marked hazards.

settlements.architecture: Plateau and gorge villages: one- and two-storey houses of dark basalt or pink and orange tuff blocks with low-pitched tin roofs, wooden balconies (Georgian gorge villages), stone churches with conical domes, Azerbaijani lowland houses of brick with walled gardens and a mosque; haystacks and dung-cake piles on the plateau.
settlements.wall_class: Stone and tuff walls 40-60 cm thick; brick medium; wooden balconies thin.
layout_rules: plateau villages compact around a church and a spring
gorge villages strung along the canyon rim
lowland villages on a grid with gardens and irrigation ditches

settlements.architecture: Regional towns: a 19th-century core of tuff and brick, Soviet five- and nine-storey blocks, a market, an Orthodox or Armenian Apostolic cathedral, a mosque in the eastern town, damaged earthquake-era buildings in one town, a railway station.
settlements.wall_class: Tuff and brick medium-thick; panel blocks thick.
layout_rules: old core on a river terrace
blocks and industry on the edge

settlements.architecture: Military, border and energy sites: border posts of the three states (concrete towers, fences, sandbagged positions), a Russian base with barracks and vehicle parks, occupied-line posts with fences and surveillance masts, pipeline pump and block-valve stations, a railway junction, demining camps.
settlements.footprint_m: border post 60x80; Russian base 1200x1000; pump station 300x300
layout_rules: border posts on hills overlooking roads
pump stations every 20-40 km along the pipeline corridor
Russian base on the plateau edge near a town

settlements.architecture: Summer shepherd camps on high pastures (stone huts, wagons, sheepfolds) and lowland farms (brick houses, cotton sheds).

infrastructure.roads: A plateau highway with a pass, gorge roads with tunnels and bridges, the lowland highway, a new transit-corridor road under construction along a southern gorge.
infrastructure.rail: Electrified line along the gorge and lowland, a railway junction, a new rail link to Turkey across the plateau.
infrastructure.power: Power lines over the ridges, a hydro plant in the gorge.
infrastructure.airfields: A Russian-used airbase on the plateau edge (AI aircraft), a regional airport in the lowland.
infrastructure.checkpoints: Border crossings between the three states and toward Turkey; the occupied-region line on the north edge with posts and moving fences; police checkpoints; construction checkpoints on the transit corridor.

pois.description: Fenced station on the buried pipeline: valve pits, control cabin, cameras, a helipad; in a lowland semi-desert.
pois.contract_use: pipeline and infrastructure guard (clients aze, geo)

pois.description: Road and rail construction site in a southern gorge: tunnels, bridge piers, cranes, contractor camp with foreign staff.
pois.contract_use: convoy escort on the transit corridor (client arm)

pois.description: Armenian or Azerbaijani border post on a hill: trenches, a concrete tower, a flag; old mined slopes below.
pois.contract_use: border post reinforcement (client arm) or border security (client aze), mutually exclusive

pois.description: Demining site on former front hills: marked lanes, flags, a demining team camp, a machine.
Village split by the occupied-region line: fences through orchards, surveillance mast, a post on the other side; detentions of villagers.
pois.contract_use: border security patrol; hostage (detained villager) recovery negotiation escort (client geo)

pois.description: Russian military base on the plateau: barracks, vehicle park with armour, air defence, a fence; restricted.
pois.contract_use: observe only; rival encounter in late game

pois.description: Steel bridge over a 150 m deep basalt gorge on the main road; a canyon village below.
Medieval stone monastery on a ridge with thick walls, a bell tower and a monks' house; overlooks two valleys.
Military training area with a drone launch site, containers and a range.
Stone hut at a high pass on a smuggling route between the occupied region and the plateau.
Lake resort with Soviet sanatorium buildings, cabins and a jetty.
pois.contract_use: VIP protection; hostage rescue (clients geo, aze)

pois.description: Railway junction with yards, a depot, fuel tanks and a station; the new line to Turkey starts here.
pois.contract_use: recover lost equipment or sensitive kit (client geo); infrastructure guard

conditions: ridge fog and thunderstorms in summer
weather.visibility_notes: Ridge fog and snow ground helicopters; plateau views are long; forests limit sightlines to 30-100 m.
weather.dust_or_snow: Heavy snow on the plateau and ridges December-March; dust in the lowland in summer.

civilians.behaviour: Farmers and shepherds; summer migration of herds to high pastures; markets in towns; border villagers live with fences and posts and avoid the line; construction workers on the transit corridor.
civilians.casualty_risk_notes: Border villages and towns are the risk; open plateau and forest zones are sparse.

factions_present.where: South-west plateau and the southern gorge (transit corridor), border posts.
Eastern lowland, pipeline stations, border posts facing the plateau; drones.
Northern half: towns, rail junction, pipeline stations, the occupied-line villages.
Russian base on the plateau (Armenian side) and posts along the occupied-region line on the north edge.
West edge border and the rail link; liaison with aze.
Smuggling and security work from the occupied region; a team near the Russian base.

frontline: A cold peace with several lines. The Armenia-Azerbaijan border is quiet but unsettled: incident events (shots across the border, drone sightings) raise alert in border-post zones and post reinforcement, demining and evacuation contracts; treaty-progress events lower it and open the transit corridor. The occupied-region line on the north edge creeps ('borderization' events move fences into villages), posting Georgian patrol and detained-villager contracts. Contracts for arm and aze are mutually exclusive (side-lock). The Russian base does not move; rus pressure appears as events and rival-PMC activity.
contract_hooks: Border post reinforcement after an incident (client arm)
Border security sweep in the lowland hills (client aze)
Demining escort on former front hills (clients arm, aze)
Convoy escort on the transit corridor through the southern gorge (client arm)
Pipeline and infrastructure guard at a block-valve station (clients aze, geo)
Border security patrol on the occupied-region line (client geo)
Hostage rescue at a crater-lake resort (clients geo, aze)
Civilian evacuation from a border village (client arm)
Counter-smuggling raid at a pass hut (client geo)

hot_zones.name: Plateau escalation (mid-late)
hot_zones.layout: Hostile HQ chosen by the side-lock (the other state's border command, or a rus/pmc_kestrel node); 4 outposts on hills and passes; checkpoints at bridges; roaming patrols and drones; 1 QRF of armour

insertion.fob: FOB at a host-state base chosen by client: plateau town (arm), lowland town (aze) or rail junction (geo). Roads and passes; helicopters weather-limited; AAVs only in the lowland.

early_game_notes: State actors only, mid tier; mid-campaign theatre.
ambient_audio: church bells and call to prayer (east)
